question:

How many people are Singers as well Dancers but not Painters?
solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4776b529a362d4e32f59a9a9d93bf954829e2f39ea12b54ba65c297a88f45e65.png]
